description: Save an unprotected copy of an encrypted PDF, given the code that opens it. Current limitation: the bundled PDF engine (pdf-lib 1.17) cannot decrypt, so encrypted input returns an error and no file is written. Input that is not encrypted is re-saved as a copy.

filePath.description: Path to the encrypted PDF file

outputPath.description: Path where the unprotected copy will be saved

unlockCode.description: Code that opens the encrypted PDF, if one is set. Leave it out for files that open without one.

name: pdf_decrypt
